label: Run 16 · all 3 chats
note: Every chat of run 16 (Zyx and Sable: run 15's briefs and characters; the chat as improvisations on seed 23, as in run 14): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer. All of them were written improvisation by improvisation to the same instructions, under IMPROVISATIONS. What the instructions fix (how each improvisation goes, the traps, how interest moves) is shared by design and is not a template, and is not held against the set: list the improvisations it decides under excused and judge only what the writers made of it.

chat.variety.why: I set aside the arc the instructions fix (clingy opener, overexplained jokes, dread narration, the unmatch at 14), so all 14 improvisations are excused for shape. What the writers built on top of that arc still repeats. In all three, Zyx's first reveal is being cropped out of the family portrait, followed by Sable's mother auditing her looks and the pre-workout dry-scoop. All three also reuse the same anecdotes almost word for word: the limescale scrub that ends with the man going soft, the ninety-second finish with a stand-up set afterwards, the 5am lint roller, and the ex ghosted over an unposed photo. Smaller lines recur too: 'breathe', 'Gandalf', 'partner in crime', 'TED talk' and an expired-promo-code madness line. Each chat does have its own moments: Joel's 'Wait. Did you actually just stop talking?... Last chance' reversal, Jimmy's 'couldn't afford you at retail', and Ali's apron-return callback. That keeps it above a 2, but the shared order of reveals and the lines repeated across all three keep it below the line.
